judged_text: feed_key is dead code — nothing in this diff ever reads or writes the 'feed-modified:...' key it describes. Maintainers are misled into believing modified-since tracking exists; in reality the entire feed is re-fetched and every item re-hashed and re-compared hourly. Deleting the method (or implementing the conditional fetch it implies) removes the false impression.

adjudication.rationale: In the new `Jobs::PollFeed` job (`app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`), the method `feed_key` computes a Redis key (`"feed-modified:..."`) but nothing in this diff ever calls `feed_key` or reads/writes that key. The actual `poll_feed` implementation always does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and iterates all items, relying on `TopicEmbed.import` to hash/compare content, so the presence of `feed_key` implies conditional/modified-since tracking that is not implemented here.
